Every Weekend, 2025
Heritage & Nature Walk

By Sair-e-Nizamuddin
Please contact: #9871066025 / 9911949854

Time: 11 a.m. and 4 p.m.

Meeting point: Coffee Kiosk, Sundar Nursery

Rs 200/- for 6 years and above

Description

Do you want to go somewhere where you can walk on the Mughal carpet and feel the grandeur? Where you can hear birds chirping while passing through world heritage sites, peacocks are spreading their wings. Where can you just walk in peace with other nature and heritage lovers? Then this is exactly what you need.
Sunder Nursery Park is home to over 300 different tree species, 80 bird species, 60 butterfly species, and six world heritage sites. Its heritage structures, which include mausoleums, garden pavilions, wells, and lotus ponds, have an intricate beauty that is unique to this era.

About Sair-e-Nizamuddin

A group of trained heritage guides formed in 2009 with a vision of involving the local community for sharing the tangible and intangible heritage of Nizamuddin Basti with the support of Aga Khan Trust for Culture.

What do you need to do:
  • Be at venue 15 minutes before time to have Maximum FUN and if you're late join in silently.
  • Keep your phones off your hands (preferred) during the walk.
  • Carry your own bottle of water.

P.S. We will be using the event picture at our social media platforms.

We also do customized walks for groups, Senior citizens and schools at reasonable price. To know more email, us at sair.nizamuddin@gmal.com
